name: APPEAL_GRV_LETTER
description: Letters that were sent or were attempted to have been sent from an appeal or grievance record.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the appeal/grievance record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: CM_PHY_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this record or line. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: LETTER_SENT_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: The contents of the letter that were delivered or are waiting to be delivered.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_LETTER_STS_C_NAME
columns.description: Where this letter is in the generation process.

columns.name: LETTER_GUID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this letter. This column can be used to join to APPEAL_GRV_LETTER_GEN_HX.LETTER_HX_GUID.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_LETTER_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: Which letter type this line counts as. Released letters correspond to common letter types for timeliness requirements and will be automatically triggered during the workflow with no additional build.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_CLASS_EVENT_ID
columns.description: The recipient class used to determine the specific recipient to send to.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_CLASS_EVENT_ID_EVENT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the event.

columns.name: RESOLVED_FEV_SEND_TO_C_NAME
columns.description: The specific type of the recipient found with the recipient class.
entries: IP Sign In - Sending Unit User
IP Sign In - Receiving Unit User
IP Sign In - Current Unit User
Bed Planning IB Pager - Sending Unit
Bed Planning IB Pager - Receiving Unit

columns.name: RESOLVED_RECIPIENT_INI
columns.description: The INItials of the master file containing the record of this letter's recipient.

columns.name: RESOLVED_RECIPIENT_ID
columns.description: The ID of the record of this letter's recipient. The corresponding value in RESOLVED_RECIPIENT_INI indicates what table this can be used to join to.

columns.name: RESOLVED_RECIPIENT_GUID
columns.description: The GUID of this letter's recipient. This column can be used to join to MEMBER_RESP_PERSON.MEM_RESP_GUID and will be populated when column RESOLVED_FEV_SEND_TO_C is set to 58 (Authorized Representative).

columns.name: DELIVERY_LOGIC_C_NAME
columns.description: When resolving a delivery method for a particular recipient, this is how we chose that delivery method.

columns.name: RESOLVED_FEV_DLVR_MTHD_C_NAME
columns.description: The ideal delivery method chosen for the recipient of this letter.
entries: Mobile App Notification, fall back to Page
Page, fall back to Mobile App Notification

columns.name: BATCH_PRINT_LTR_HX_JOB_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: If a letter was submitted to batch print to be mailed out, this is the job type that the letter was queued to.

columns.name: BODY_SMARTTEXT_ID
columns.description: When the letter was created, this is the SmartText template that we used to generate the contents of the body.

columns.name: BODY_SMARTTEXT_ID_SMARTTEXT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the SmartText record.

columns.name: COVER_SMARTTEXT_ID
columns.description: When the letter was created, this is the SmartText template that we used to generate the cover sheet which was rendered before the body.

columns.name: COVER_SMARTTEXT_ID_SMARTTEXT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the SmartText record.

columns.name: BACK_SMARTTEXT_ID
columns.description: When the letter was created, this is the SmartText template that we used to generate the back sheet which was rendered after the body.

columns.name: BACK_SMARTTEXT_ID_SMARTTEXT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the SmartText record.

columns.name: RESOLVED_IB_POOL_ID
columns.description: If this letter was sent as an In Basket message, this will store the pool that we delivered to.

columns.name: RESOLVED_IB_POOL_ID_REGISTRY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the In Basket registry in the HIP master file.

columns.name: RESOLVED_PROV_ADDR_UNIQUE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the provider's address when the resolved recipient is a provider. This can be used to join to CLARITY_SER_ADDR in combination with column RESOLVED_RECIPIENT_ID when RESOLVED_RECIPIENT_INI = 'SER'.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: The city of this letter's recipient. A city may be recorded, even if the letter was not mailed.

columns.name: STATE_C_NAME
columns.description: A category value for the state of this letter's recipient. A state may be recorded, even if the letter was not mailed. This is usually the same as the internal ID. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Community ID (CID).

columns.name: ZIP
columns.description: The ZIP code of this letter's recipient. A ZIP code may be recorded, even if the letter was not mailed.

columns.name: DISTRICT_C_NAME
columns.description: A category value for the district of this letter's recipient. A district may be recorded, even if the letter was not mailed. This is usually the same as the internal ID. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Community ID (CID).

columns.name: COUNTY_C_NAME
columns.description: A category value for the county of this letter's recipient. A county may be recorded, even if the letter was not mailed. This is usually the same as the internal ID. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Community ID (CID).

columns.name: COUNTRY_C_NAME
columns.description: A category value for the country of this letter's recipient. A country may be recorded, even if the letter was not mailed. This is usually the same as the internal ID. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Community ID (CID).

columns.name: BUILDING_NUMBER
columns.description: The building/house number of this letter's recipient. A building/house number may be recorded, even if the letter was not mailed.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_NAME
columns.description: The name of this letter's recipient.
